'''Kasa Xanter''' was a famous [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] from [[Aurea]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She sculpted the ''[[Dawn of Light]]''.
